wave: recent-K protected continuation on the already-quantised execution, judged on a new held-out bank
status: FORECAST — frozen before implementation; the execution record goes in continuation-codec-3-notes.json and this file is not edited
question: When codec-recent/v1 (4-bit, the newest 256 K rows of every layer exact) replaces exact K/V on the Q4_K-weight execution LARQL ships, does it pass CODEC-2's frozen rules — which uniform 4-bit codec/v1 failed — on a held-out text no arm has run on?
why: CODEC-2 closed NOT ACCEPTABLE on its tail rule (B3 upper 0.617 against 0.290; continuation-codec-2-notes.json, closure). CODEC-MAP-1 (#654) localised that tail on calibration text to recent K, with a strong interaction: protecting the newest 256 K rows removed 94% of CH's worst-5% incremental damage in simulation. The CODEC-3 reconnaissance (#655) built the real provider, proved it scores identically to that simulation, measured its residency exactly, and chose w = 256 by a rule declared before its sweep (w = 128 missed that rule's wide-tail threshold by under a point). This freeze asks whether the calibration result holds on new text, by the rules that failed codec/v1

decomposition.B_verdict: the incremental damage the primary arm (acceptance.rule_binding.primary) adds to the already-quantised execution — C ↔ primary, both scored against R on the same positions, paired
decomposition.secondary: the secondary arm (acceptance.rule_binding.secondary_report_only) measured identically (B1–B4 and every reported quantity) and reported separately. It is REPORT-ONLY: its result cannot change the primary verdict, rescue a failed primary, or replace it
decomposition.reference_CH: CH (uniform codec/v1) is re-measured on bank 3 under B1–B4 and reported, not adjudicated: it says whether CODEC-2's failure recurs on this text, so a CH-recent result is read against its own control
decomposition.end_to_end: R ↔ each candidate; reported, not adjudicated

CODEC-2's bank-2 verdict and its pooled statistics (closure). During the bank-3 rule audit the designer read the passage's first sentence and its last ~300 characters, and the list of dropped heading paragraphs; no other passage text was read

acceptance.text: the frozen held-out bank continuation-codec-3-token-bank.json (8,193 IDs, sha256 80d188d3… over u32 LE; New Grub Street, Gissing, Gutenberg #1709, passage committed beside it) is the authority: every arm consumes exactly those IDs, digest verified at load; an arm fed any other sequence is inadmissible
acceptance.scored_positions: rungs 2,048, 4,096 and 8,192 total positions; each journey is prefill n − 1,040, resume 16, decode 1,024, and every decode step's full logit row is scored teacher-forced (position start + i predicts ID start + i + 1). 3 × 1,024 = 3,072 scored positions. The 1,024 rung of CODEC-1 is not used: it cannot hold 1,024 decode positions after its resume. Rung is confounded with text (each rung scores a different passage); per-rung results are findings, never a length law
acceptance.metric: represent/measure/plan/metrics.rs position_metrics, unchanged, over the FULL logit width (262,208): per position KL(R‖·) in f64 nats, top-1 agreement with R, R's margin (top-1 minus top-2 probability). Every scored arm is scored against R

guards.rule: any guard failure makes the run UNINFORMATIVE, not a pass and not a fail
guards.bank: every arm consumes bank 3 (digest verified at load)
guards.null: NULL is KL 0 with the same top-1 at every scored position of every rung
guards.bindings: C, CH, CH-recent256 and CH-recent128 recorded selections bind the Q4_K pack; R and NULL bind the full-precision stack
guards.A_yardstick_usable: pooled over the three rungs: top-1 agreement(R, C) ≥ 0.70 AND mean KL(R‖C) ≤ 0.50 nats. Its job is narrow — C is not so broken that an incremental comparison is meaningless. Bank 1 measured 0.796 [0.775, 0.816] and 0.243 [0.201, 0.289]; the bounds sit far outside those intervals so an ordinary text passes and a broken yardstick does not
guards.residency_regression: CH's codec residency equals CODEC-1's declared formula exactly, and CH-recent256's and CH-recent128's mixed residency equals what their window declares exactly (the CODEC-3 reconnaissance's equation: V codes + aged K codes + min(w, held) exact K rows + the row lists, derived from the retained range; 0 strays, 0 window mismatches, scratch within bound), at every rung end; a failure stops the run as a provider or instrument fault
guards.trace: each CH-recent arm's retention-and-read trace equals CH's at every rung (the window changes bytes per row, never which rows are held or read); a mismatch stops the run as a provider fault

rule.subject: CH is ACCEPTABLE only if every guard passes and B1–B4 all hold, pooled over the three rungs (n = 3,072 paired positions); NOT ACCEPTABLE if any adjudicated rule fails; otherwise (a guard failed, or B4 lacks support and B1–B3 hold) UNINFORMATIVE. Each rule is also reported per rung; a rung that fails a rule the pool passes is recorded as a finding, not smoothed
rule.B1_top1_noninferiority: with b = #positions where CH agrees with R and C does not, c = #positions where C agrees and CH does not: diff = (b − c)/n, se = sqrt((b + c) − (b − c)²/n)/n, lower = diff − 1.6449 × se. HOLDS iff lower ≥ −δ, δ = 0.03 (reconnaissance power table: δ = 0.03 at 80% power needs ≤ 3,072 positions for discordance up to ~0.45)
rule.B2_kl_mean_noninferiority: d_i = KL(R‖CH)_i − KL(R‖C)_i. Upper = the 95th percentile, over the stratified bootstrap replicates, of the replicate's mean of d. HOLDS iff upper ≤ ε, ε = 0.25 × pooled mean KL(R‖C) of the same run (point estimate) — compression may add at most a quarter of the damage weight quantisation already adds
rule.B3_tail: the PAIRED incremental tail, on the same d_i as B2 (the reconnaissance: a tail rule is stated on paired quantities, not on two separately computed p99s). Upper = the 95th percentile, over the same stratified bootstrap replicates, of the replicate's nearest-rank p99 of d. HOLDS iff upper ≤ 0.25 × pooled nearest-rank p99 KL(R‖C) of the same run (point estimate) — at the 99th percentile of incremental damage, compression adds no more than a quarter of C's existing p99 error
rule.B4_confident_band: B1's paired McNemar bound restricted to the positions where R's margin ≥ 0.9 (n_conf of them): with b, c counted within the band, lower = (b − c)/n_conf − 1.6449 × sqrt((b + c) − (b − c)²/n_conf)/n_conf. Minimum support N_MIN = 350: if n_conf < 350, B4 is UNINFORMATIVE (and so is an otherwise-passing verdict); else B4 HOLDS iff lower ≥ −δ. N_MIN is the positions a δ = 0.03 non-inferiority test needs at 80% power for band discordance up to 0.05 — about 5× C's own in-band flip rate on bank 1 (0.011); bank 1's band share (24.3%) projects ~750 band positions at 3,072. The band is relative to C: on bank 1, C scores 0.989 there, and no absolute bar near 0.995 is reachable by C on any band
rule.bootstrap: B2 and B3 share one STRATIFIED block bootstrap. Each rung's 1,024 scored positions form 32 non-overlapping blocks of 32 consecutive positions (block length from the reconnaissance). Every replicate samples, with replacement, exactly 32 blocks from rung 2,048, 32 from rung 4,096 and 32 from rung 8,192, and pools the resulting 3,072 positions — the rungs are different passages, and the experiment fixes each at one third, so no replicate may reweight them. 10,000 replicates, driven by SplitMix64 seeded 0xC0DEC2, so every bound is reproducible

reported_not_adjudicated: CH and CH-recent128 under B1–B4, pooled and per rung, with the same bootstrap
R ↔ each arm: KL mean/p50/p99/max, top-1, per rung and per margin band
KL(C‖·) per position for each compressed arm
the B statistics per rung; McNemar's b and c for every arm
resident bytes at each rung end per arm (CH, CH-recent256, CH-recent128), by class (V codes, K codes, exact K, lists) and as a multiple of CH's
wall time per arm, under MEM-1 instrumentation — not a decode-cost measurement
acceptance.reading: a pass says: on Gemma 3 4B IT and this held-out text, keeping the newest 256 K rows of every layer exact while storing older K and all V at 4 bits does not materially worsen the shipped Q4_K execution's agreement with the full-precision reference, by the margins CODEC-2 froze. It is not a claim about other models (the map is a Gemma finding until other architectures are measured), other windows, other bit widths, other texts, losslessness, or decode cost

anti_cheat: the rule and every constant are CODEC-2's and are not changed; the primary window 256, the secondary 128 and bank 3 are fixed here; none is changed after any bank-3 arm runs. The secondary cannot become the primary after results are seen. A failed guard is UNINFORMATIVE and is not re-run with altered bounds — a new question is a new freeze. C, CH and both CH-recent arms share one store and one prepared operand set, so they differ only in the continuation provider. codec/v1 and codec-recent/v1 are not changed between freeze and run

next: if CH-recent256 holds: the materialisation/decode-cost rung for codec-recent/v1, and the exact window's precision as a representation question. Either way, the cross-architecture rung: CODEC-MAP-1's localisation (K/V, depth, attention type, age) re-run on structurally different models (Granite, Qwen 3.x; Kimi or another hybrid as the expected different regime) to ask whether 'recent K fragile, V tolerant, older K compressible' recurs.
